commands.description: One batched read of host, OS, uptime, load, CPU counters, memory, disks and reboot flag. Sections start with a '##name' line.
commands.script: echo '##hostname'; hostname; echo '##os'; cat /etc/os-release; echo '##uptime'; cat /proc/uptime; echo '##loadavg'; cat /proc/loadavg; echo '##nproc'; nproc; echo '##stat'; head -1 /proc/stat; echo '##meminfo'; grep -E '^(MemTotal|MemAvailable):' /proc/meminfo; echo '##df'; df -P -B1 -x tmpfs -x devtmpfs -x squashfs -x overlay 2>/dev/null; echo '##reboot'; if [ -f /var/run/reboot-required ]; then echo yes; else echo no; fi
